prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Daggerfall Unity portrait eye atlas, constrained pixel-art edit.
Input image: Image 1 is the sole reference and exact 2x2 grid. Four identical upper-half face crops, each 64x35 source pixels magnified 8x, no other reference.
Primary request: Create the neutral eye atlas by editing only the eyelids in this existing atlas. Preserve the original portrait rather than redrawing it. Exactly four complete, equal cells in 2 columns by 2 rows, without spaces or borders. Row-major: open, half closed, closed, repeated open. The open cells (top-left and bottom-right) must reproduce the source crop exactly. Half and closed phases change only vertical lid coverage. Keep the eyeballs, both pupils and irises identical in size and horizontal position in all phases; the lid slides down over the same fixed eyeball. Brows and creases stay stationary. Neutral, calm, straight gaze in both eyes.
Geometry: match the input grid's exact aspect ratio and repeated cell framing. Each cell is the original upper64x35 crop, retaining original relative pixel dimensions and face scale. Preserve the original pixel-art pixels and colors everywhere except the small eyelid pixels that must change.
Style/medium: very low-resolution 1990s game portrait pixel art, chunky nearest-neighbor squares on the source's 8x enlargement; no modern repaint, no interpolation, no antialiasing.
Color palette: exact muted olive-green iris, tan and medium-brown skin, restrained dark-brown brows and lids, softly shaded low contrast. No orange or red hue shift.
Constraints: no added or blue pixels, no bright white eye flash, no enlarged eyes or irises, no thick black brows, no smoothing, makeup, glow or hard shadows. Preserve hair, forehead, nose bridge, spacing, skin, background and crop. No full faces, newly framed portraits, zoom, crop, rescaled cells, gutter, padding, labels, lines or extra grid. Do not invent any content outside the original upper-half crops.
The paired mouth atlas meanings, included as required contract context but not to draw here: A closed pressured P/B/M; B narrow opening and nearly together teeth for consonants/EE; C medium unrounded EH/AE; D wide AA; E slightly rounded AO/ER no wider than C; F puckered UW/OW/W; G upper teeth touching lower lip for F/V; H tongue raised behind upper teeth L with opening between C and D; X relaxed closed idle.
